title: 防洪抽水站機組整合~Flood-pumping-station integration
focus: 連結水理、電源、儲水與故障情境的抽水站整合~Integrating pump hydraulics power storage and failure scenarios
summary: 本課由內水收支與系統揚程進入並聯泵、效率、變速、啟停及吸入條件，再串接電源、閘門與備援能力。上環與西部封閉綜合工程提供不同尺度的實例，所有算例為原創簡化條件；課程要求可追溯驗證與失效界面分析，不將教學數字當現場操作設定。~The course moves from interior-water balance and system head to parallel units, efficiency, speed, cycling and suction conditions, then integrates power, gates and retained capacity. Sheung Wan and the West Closure Complex provide examples at different scales. Every calculation is an original simplification, requiring traceable verification and interface analysis rather than treating lesson values as field operating settings.

units.anchor: 內水蓄積與抽排收支~Interior storage and pumping balance
units.title: 內水蓄積與抽排收支機理與驗證~Interior storage and pumping balance mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 防洪抽水站處理的是隨時間進入低窪區的水量，而不是單一固定流量。外河高水位關閉重力出口時，集水池與上游管網共同儲存未排出的水，水位上升速度取決於淨入流和有效面積；抽水能力需要與降雨逕流、儲水曲線和外水位成組分析，不能只比較泵銘牌與最大入流。本例在短時間內固定面積和進出流量，假設沒有其他溢流或滲流；不是整場洪水演算，也未描述管網局部積水。~A flood station handles a time-varying inflow rather than one fixed discharge. When high receiving water closes a gravity outlet, the sump and upstream network store unremoved water; rise rate depends on net inflow and effective surface area. Pumping must be evaluated with runoff, storage curves and receiving stage rather than merely comparing nameplate capacity with peak inflow. The short-step example fixes area and flows and excludes other overflow or seepage. It is neither full-event routing nor a description of local network flooding.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設入流Qi=6、抽排Qp=4 m³/s、時間Δt=300 s、有效面積A=600 m²，水位升幅Δh=(Qi−Qp)Δt/A=1.00 m。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume inflow Qi=6, pumping Qp=4 m³/s, Δt=300 s and effective area A=600 m². Rise Δh=(Qi−Qp)Δt/A=1.00 m.
units.verify: 以同步雨量、入流、泵流量和池水位核對每個時間步的體積收支，確認有效面積是否隨水位改變。將溢流、重力排水與閘門狀態分開記錄，避免把未知出口造成的差額歸因感測誤差。~Reconcile stepwise volumes with synchronized rainfall, inflow, pumping and sump level, checking whether effective area changes with stage. Record overflow, gravity discharge and gate state separately so that an unrecognized outlet is not incorrectly absorbed into a sensor-error correction.
units.failure: 只用最大泵量而忽略高外水位的實際工況會高估抽排，漏掉上游管網蓄水則可能錯估池水位變化；淨入流長時間為正時，有限儲量終究會耗盡。~Using maximum pump flow without the high-tailwater operating point overstates drainage. Omitting upstream network storage distorts sump response, and persistently positive net inflow eventually exhausts finite available storage.
units.misconception: 泵的標示總流量大於平均雨水流量，就能保證任何洪水不積水。~Total labeled pump flow above mean runoff guarantees no flooding in any event.
units.practice: 建立五分鐘體積帳並逐步更新池水位，讓其中一段抽排量降低。指出峰值入流比較與全事件體積演算各會發現什麼問題，並標記需要水位面積曲線的區段。~Build a five-minute volume ledger with sequential stage updates and reduce pumping during one interval. Explain the different problems revealed by peak-flow comparison and full-event volume routing, marking where a stage-area curve becomes necessary.

units.anchor: 系統揚程與外水位~System head and receiving stage
units.title: 系統揚程與外水位機理與驗證~System head and receiving stage mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 泵需要克服內外水面差與管路損失，外河或海潮升高會改變系統曲線並移動工作點。靜揚程可隨內水位上升而降低，但摩阻通常隨流量增加，兩者不能混成固定總揚程；不同閘門與出口狀態也會改變損失，需為代表工況建立一致的能量帳。本例用二次損失近似固定配置的系統曲線，係數帶有單位；不涵蓋氣塞、虹吸建立或瞬變逆流。~A pump overcomes the difference between interior and receiving surfaces plus hydraulic losses. Rising river or tide shifts the system curve and operating point. Static head can decrease as the sump rises, while friction generally increases with flow; they cannot be collapsed into one fixed total head. Gate and outlet states also require separate, consistent energy balances. The example uses a quadratic loss approximation for a fixed configuration, with a dimensional coefficient. It excludes trapped air, siphon establishment and transient reverse flow.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設靜揚程Hs=3.0 m、損失係數K=0.20 s²/m⁵、流量Q=4.0 m³/s，Hsys=Hs+KQ²=6.20 m。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume static head Hs=3.0 m, loss coefficient K=0.20 s²/m⁵ and flow Q=4.0 m³/s. System head Hsys=Hs+KQ²=6.20 m.
units.verify: 量測內外水位並核對同一高程基準，將流量、閥位及壓差配對以辨認系統損失。分別檢查高外水位、低內水位及部分堵塞工況，不把單次測試曲線直接套用全部事件。~Measure interior and receiving stages on one datum, pairing flow, valve position and pressure difference to identify system losses. Examine high tailwater, low sump level and partial blockage separately rather than applying one test curve unchanged to every storm condition.
units.failure: 把外水位忽略會在最需要抽排時高估流量，將靜揚程當成全部揚程又會低估摩阻；出口堵塞或閥位改變可使原有工作點預測失效。~Omitting tailwater overstates flow when drainage is most needed, while treating static head as total head understates friction. Outlet blockage or changed valve position can invalidate the originally predicted operating point.
units.misconception: 防洪泵在所有外河水位下都會維持同一銘牌流量。~A flood pump maintains the same nameplate flow at every receiving-river level.
units.practice: 畫出兩種外水位的系統曲線，保持管路損失係數不變。說明曲線移動如何影響與泵曲線的交點，再列出哪些構件改變會使係數也必須更新。~Draw system curves for two receiving stages while holding the loss coefficient fixed. Explain their changed intersections with the pump curve, then identify component changes that would also require updating the coefficient.

units.anchor: 並聯機組與共同管路~Parallel pumps and common pipework
units.title: 並聯機組與共同管路機理與驗證~Parallel pumps and common pipework mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 並聯泵在相同揚程下疊加流量，但共同管路的摩阻會隨總流量增加，因此加開第二台通常不會使站流量正好加倍。不同機組曲線、止回閥及局部損失還可能造成不均分流，甚至讓一台落在不利區域；整合時須同時解機組與系統曲線，而不是把型錄數字相加。以下兩台完全相同且均分流量，泵曲線與系統曲線均為教學二次式；沒有替代實機穩定區、效率及汽蝕檢查。~Parallel pumps add flow at a common head, but shared-pipe friction grows with total flow, so a second pump generally does not double station discharge. Different unit curves, check valves and local losses can create uneven sharing or an unfavorable operating region. Integration therefore solves pump and system curves together rather than adding catalog values. The two units are identical and share flow equally, with hypothetical quadratic pump and system curves. This does not replace real-machine stability, efficiency or cavitation checks.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設單泵Hp=10−0.25q² m、系統Hs=3+0.20Q² m，q、Q以m³/s計；兩泵Q=2q得Q=2√(7/1.05)=5.164 m³/s。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume pump Hp=10−0.25q² m and system Hs=3+0.20Q² m, with q,Q in m³/s. Two pumps give Q=2q=2√(7/1.05)=5.164 m³/s.
units.verify: 以每台支路流量、共同揚程及轉速驗證分流，核對曲線使用的流量單位與機組組合。比較單台及多台實測交點，檢查止回閥開啟與低流量穩定性，再評估剩餘備援能力。~Verify sharing from individual branch flows, common head and speed, checking curve units and pump combinations. Compare measured single- and multiple-unit intersections, inspect check-valve opening and low-flow stability, and only then assess the drainage capability retained under backup arrangements.
units.failure: 直接把單台工況流量乘台數會忽略共同摩阻，異型泵也可能出現分流失衡；名義總容量足夠時，某台仍可能偏離允許運轉區而增加振動或過熱。~Multiplying a single-unit operating flow by unit count ignores shared friction, and dissimilar pumps may share unevenly. Even with adequate nominal total capacity, an individual unit can leave its acceptable range and experience vibration or overheating.
units.misconception: 兩台並聯泵的實際排水量必定是單台接原管路時的兩倍。~Two parallel pumps always deliver twice the single-pump flow through the original system.
units.practice: 先解單台交點，再解兩台交點並比較增加比例。將一台泵曲線稍微下移，說明均分流量假設為何不再成立，以及需要補量測哪個支路。~Solve single- and two-pump intersections and compare the increase. Shift one pump curve downward slightly, explaining why equal sharing then fails and which branch measurements would be needed to determine the new distribution.

units.anchor: 電功率與效率鏈~Electrical power and efficiency chain
units.title: 電功率與效率鏈機理與驗證~Electrical power and efficiency chain mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 抽水的水力功率由流量和總揚程決定，馬達輸入還須考慮泵、傳動與電機效率。不同效率應對應各自能量邊界，不能重複扣同一損失；峰值功率、啟動需求與整場耗電又是不同問題，平均節能指標不足以代表防洪事件中的供電能力。本例泵與馬達效率分開且忽略其他輔機，計算穩態實功率；不包含啟動電流、功率因數或發電機瞬態容量。~Hydraulic power follows flow and total head, while motor input includes pump, transmission and electrical efficiencies. Each efficiency must correspond to a distinct energy boundary so losses are not counted twice. Peak power, starting demand and event energy are separate questions; a mean energy metric does not establish electrical adequacy during a flood. Pump and motor efficiencies are separate and auxiliary loads are excluded. The result is steady real power, not starting current, power factor or generator transient capacity.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設ρ=1000 kg/m³、Q=4 m³/s、H=6 m、ηp=0.75、ηm=0.95，P=ρgQH/(ηpηm)=330.44 kW，g=9.81 m/s²。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume ρ=1000 kg/m³, Q=4 m³/s, H=6 m, ηp=0.75, ηm=0.95 and g=9.81 m/s². Input P=ρgQH/(ηpηm)=330.44 kW.
units.verify: 同步量測流量、揚程與電表實功率，核對效率曲線是否對應當時轉速和負載。將輔機與馬達邊界分開，另記錄啟動電壓和電流，避免以穩態功率測試代替啟動能力驗證。~Measure flow, head and real electrical power synchronously, checking efficiency curves against actual speed and load. Separate auxiliaries from motor boundaries and record starting voltage and current independently so that a steady-power test is not mistaken for validation of starting capability.
units.failure: 把泵效率當成整體效率會低估供電需求，使用額定高效率代替偏離工況的效率也會造成偏差；只看平均千瓦可能忽略啟動壓降使其他機組掉電。~Using pump efficiency as overall efficiency understates electrical demand, and rated efficiency can misrepresent off-design operation. Average kilowatts can also conceal a starting voltage dip that disconnects other operating units.
units.misconception: 水力功率就是抽水站電表功率，不必計入馬達和泵的損失。~Hydraulic power equals metered station power without pump or motor losses.
units.practice: 畫出電表、馬達軸與水流三個能量邊界，將效率放在正確位置。比較泵效率下降而其他條件固定時的輸入功率，再指出啟動分析尚缺的電氣資料。~Draw meter, motor-shaft and water-flow energy boundaries with efficiencies at the correct interfaces. Compare input power after reduced pump efficiency at fixed conditions, then identify electrical information still missing for a starting analysis.

units.anchor: 變速相似與實際工況~Speed affinity and operating conditions
units.title: 變速相似與實際工況機理與驗證~Speed affinity and operating conditions mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 幾何相同的泵在相似工況下，流量、揚程和軸功率可依轉速比例建立近似關係，適合檢查性能曲線變化。實際站的靜揚程不隨轉速縮放，因此新工作點未必位於相似點；效率、汽蝕與低速穩定區也可能改變，不能把轉速平方或立方律直接當成整站保證。本例假設同一葉輪與近似相同效率，僅比較相似點；實際抽排量必須再與未同比縮放的系統曲線求交。~For a geometrically unchanged pump at homologous conditions, flow, head and shaft power approximately scale with speed, supporting a curve-shift check. Station static head does not scale with speed, so the new operating point need not be homologous. Efficiency, cavitation and low-speed stability may change, preventing direct use of square or cube laws as station-wide guarantees. The example assumes one impeller and approximately unchanged efficiency and compares homologous points only. Actual discharge requires intersecting the shifted pump curve with the system curve.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設轉速比N2/N1=0.90，相似點Q2/Q1=0.90、H2/H1=0.81、P2/P1=0.729。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume speed ratio N2/N1=0.90. At homologous points Q2/Q1=0.90, H2/H1=0.81 and P2/P1=0.729.
units.verify: 將原泵曲線按相似律移動後與實際系統曲線重求交點，核對效率、允許轉速和汽蝕資料。用現地量測驗證結果，尤其檢查靜揚程占比高時是否仍能維持有效出流。~Shift the pump curve using affinity laws and solve its intersection with the actual system curve, checking efficiency, allowed speed and cavitation data. Validate with field observations, especially whether useful discharge remains when static head forms a large share of total head.
units.failure: 直接宣稱降速一成必節電百分之二十七點一，會忽略新工作點和效率改變；靜揚程較大時，低速泵可能無法克服外水位而幾乎沒有抽排。~Claiming a guaranteed 27.1-percent saving from a ten-percent speed reduction ignores the changed operating point and efficiency. With substantial static head, a slower pump may barely overcome receiving water and provide little drainage.
units.misconception: 泵降速一成，整站一定同時少抽一成水且省下固定立方比例電力。~Reducing speed ten percent guarantees ten percent less station flow and fixed cube-law energy savings.
units.practice: 畫出含靜揚程與不含靜揚程兩條系統曲線，比較同一降速泵曲線的交點。指出相似點與實際工作點的差別，避免把兩種比例放在同一張效益表。~Draw system curves with and without static head and compare intersections with one reduced-speed pump curve. Distinguish homologous points from operating points so their ratios are not mixed in a performance table.

units.anchor: 啟停水位差與循環~Level hysteresis and cycling
units.title: 啟停水位差與循環機理與驗證~Level hysteresis and cycling mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 單台泵的啟停水位差形成可用調節容積，能減少頻繁啟動，但過大水位帶可能占用防洪儲量或降低淹沒裕度。填充與抽降時間分別受入流及淨抽出量控制，不可只用池容積除以泵流量；多台輪替、變入流與感測遲延會讓實際循環更複雜。本例為一台泵、固定池面積與固定入流，且抽排大於入流；算得啟動頻率只是比較，不是設備允許值或現場設定。~The start-stop level band creates regulating volume that can reduce repeated starts, but an excessive band may consume flood storage or reduce submergence margin. Filling and drawdown depend on inflow and net pumping respectively, not simply volume divided by pump flow. Multiple-unit rotation, variable inflow and sensing delay further complicate actual cycling. The example uses one pump, constant area and inflow, with pumping exceeding inflow. Its start frequency is a comparison, not an equipment limit or field setting.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設A=100 m²、啟停差Δh=0.60 m、Qi=0.50、Qp=2.0 m³/s；循環T=60/0.50+60/(2−0.50)=160 s，即22.5次/h。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume A=100 m², level band Δh=0.60 m, Qi=0.50 and Qp=2.0 m³/s. Cycle T=60/0.50+60/(2−0.50)=160 s, or 22.5 starts/h.
units.verify: 用事件紀錄核對啟動、停止、入流及池水位，檢查每次實際抽降時間與計算差異。將設備可允許啟動次數、最小運轉時間及池體淹沒條件一起核對，避免只靠一條水位帶決策。~Check starts, stops, inflow and sump level against event logs, comparing actual and calculated drawdown time. Review permitted starts, minimum run time and submergence together rather than deciding from the level band alone, and record any delayed switching behavior.
units.failure: 漏掉持續入流會低估抽降時間，水位噪訊可能使接點反覆切換；為減少啟動而任意擴大水位帶，則可能犧牲暴雨時原本可用的儲水空間。~Ignoring continuing inflow understates drawdown time, and level noise can chatter the switching signal. Enlarging the band solely to reduce starts may consume storage that would otherwise be available during heavy rainfall.
units.misconception: 啟停週期等於調節容積除以泵流量，入流大小完全無關。~The start-stop cycle equals regulating volume divided by pump flow and is independent of inflow.
units.practice: 分開計算填充與抽降時間，再把入流改成原值兩倍觀察循環變化。將水位帶、可用防洪儲量和最低淹沒畫在同一剖面，說明三者的限制關係。~Calculate fill and drawdown times separately, then double inflow and examine the cycle change. Show the level band, available flood storage and minimum submergence on one section, explaining how their constraints interact.

units.anchor: 吸入工況與流場品質~Suction conditions and flow quality
units.title: 吸入工況與流場品質機理與驗證~Suction conditions and flow quality mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 抽水站入口須同時滿足壓力裕度與均勻流場，池水位足夠也可能因不對稱入流而產生渦流與捲氣。淨正吸入水頭取決於大氣壓、吸入水位、蒸氣壓及損失，設備需求又隨流量和轉速變動；整合多台機組時應檢查不同組合造成的流場，不能只驗證全開狀態。下式各項均以同一淡水密度的水頭表示，水面高於泵參考取正；正差值不保證沒有渦流、捲氣或其他吸入問題。~Pump inlets need both pressure margin and acceptable flow quality; adequate depth can still coexist with vortices from asymmetric inflow. Available NPSH depends on atmospheric pressure, sump level, vapor pressure and losses, while required NPSH varies with flow and speed. Integrating several units requires checking different combinations rather than testing only all-units-on operation. All terms are freshwater heads on one density basis, with surface above the pump reference positive. A positive margin does not guarantee absence of vortices, air entrainment or other inlet problems.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設大氣水頭10.3 m、靜淹水1.5 m、蒸氣壓水頭0.25 m、吸入損失1.2 m，NPSHa=10.35 m。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume atmospheric head 10.3 m, static submergence 1.5 m, vapor head 0.25 m and suction loss 1.2 m. Available NPSH is 10.35 m.
units.verify: 以低池水位、高水溫及代表機組組合檢查吸入壓力，核對泵參考高程與需求曲線。另用速度分布、渦流觀察或適用模型驗證入口品質，將汽蝕壓力與捲氣問題分開判讀。~Check suction pressure at low sump level, high water temperature and representative unit combinations, verifying pump datum and required curves. Independently examine velocity distribution and vortices through observations or suitable models, keeping cavitation-pressure and air-entrainment assessments distinct in the evidence.
units.failure: 只以池水深推定無汽蝕會忽略入口損失與溫度，某些機組停用後也可能產生偏流；入口整流改善一種組合時，未必同時改善其他組合。~Inferring cavitation freedom from depth alone ignores entrance losses and temperature. Idle units can change approach symmetry, and an intake modification improving one combination may not improve all other operating combinations.
units.misconception: 池水位只要夠高，任何機組組合都不可能出現渦流或汽蝕。~Sufficient sump level makes vortices or cavitation impossible for every pump combination.
units.practice: 列出全開、單台與相鄰一台停用三種流場檢查，分別指出壓力與速度證據。計算一個增加入口損失的情境，說明同樣水位也會改變吸入裕度。~List all-on, single-unit and adjacent-unit-out checks, distinguishing pressure from velocity evidence. Calculate a case with greater entrance loss and explain why identical sump level can still produce a different suction margin.

units.anchor: 實功率視在功率與備援~Real apparent and backup power
units.title: 實功率視在功率與備援機理與驗證~Real apparent and backup power mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 備援電源須供應泵、控制和輔機，實功率與視在功率是不同容量約束，功率因數不能被效率取代。機組啟動時的電流與電壓暫降可能決定可行組合，即使連續千瓦需求足夠也不代表能順利啟動；燃料、冷卻及淹水隔離另影響可維持的事件時間。本例只換算平衡穩態負載的視在功率，不提供發電機選型容量；啟動、諧波及備援輔機需求尚未加入。~Backup supply serves pumps, controls and auxiliaries. Real and apparent power impose different constraints, and power factor is not efficiency. Starting current and voltage dip can determine feasible combinations even when continuous kilowatts appear adequate. Fuel, cooling and flood isolation separately influence how long the station can continue through an event. The example converts a balanced steady load to apparent power only, not generator selection capacity. Starting, harmonics and backup auxiliary demand remain excluded.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設穩態實功率P=500 kW、功率因數pf=0.80，視在功率S=P/pf=625 kVA。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume steady real power P=500 kW and power factor pf=0.80. Apparent power S=P/pf=625 kVA.
units.verify: 建立機組與輔機負載表，分開持續千瓦、千伏安及啟動事件，核對供電邊界和保護配合。以受控測試記錄電壓、頻率和恢復時間，另檢查燃料及冷卻不會受同一洪水中斷。~Build a pump-and-auxiliary load list separating continuous kilowatts, kilovolt-amperes and starts, checking supply boundaries and protection coordination. Record voltage, frequency and recovery in controlled tests, and independently verify that fuel and cooling are not interrupted by the same flood exposure.
units.failure: 把千瓦直接當千伏安會低估電氣容量，忽略啟動可能造成連鎖跳脫；備援發電機若與主配電共處易淹位置，也可能在需要時一起失效。~Equating kilowatts with kilovolt-amperes understates electrical capacity, and omitted starting demand can trigger cascading trips. A backup generator sharing a flood-prone location with main distribution can fail at the same time it is needed.
units.misconception: 備援電源連續千瓦足夠，就代表所有泵可以同時順利啟動。~Adequate continuous backup kilowatts guarantee that all pumps can start simultaneously.
units.practice: 把三個假設負載分成持續與啟動兩張表，再計算同一實功率在不同功率因數下的視在功率。指出仍需電源動態資料才能判斷的啟動問題。~Separate three hypothetical loads into continuous and starting tables, then compare apparent power at different power factors for the same real load. Identify starting questions that still require dynamic supply information rather than steady arithmetic.

units.anchor: 外水倒灌與閘門界面~Backflow and gate interfaces
units.title: 外水倒灌與閘門界面機理與驗證~Backflow and gate interfaces mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 外水高於內水時，重力出口可能成為倒灌通道，閘門和止回構件的作用必須與抽排路徑協調。兩側水壓的差額決定部分靜水載荷，但實際關閉還涉及摩擦、浮物、動水與機構力；把閘門關閉訊號當成水密保證，會掩蓋漏水或位置感測錯誤。本例為同底高程直立矩形門兩側靜水合力差，不含動水與摩擦，也不直接給出致動器推力或關閉時機。~When receiving water exceeds interior stage, a gravity outlet can become a backflow path, requiring coordination of gates and check devices with pumping routes. Differential hydrostatic pressure supplies part of the static load, but closure also involves friction, debris, moving water and actuator forces. A closed indication is not proof of watertightness or correct position sensing. The example is the difference in hydrostatic resultants on a vertical rectangular gate with a common bottom datum. It excludes flow and friction and does not specify actuator force or closure timing.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設水重度γ=9.81 kN/m³、門寬b=2 m、外水深ho=3 m、內水深hi=1 m，淨力F=γb(ho²−hi²)/2=78.48 kN。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume γ=9.81 kN/m³, gate width b=2 m, outside depth ho=3 m and inside hi=1 m. Net force F=γb(ho²−hi²)/2=78.48 kN.
units.verify: 核對門底和兩側水位基準，將位置回饋、實際行程及漏流量交叉檢查。測試狀態介面時保留閘門與泵的時間紀錄，並依核准操作文件確認不會形成封閉抽排或倒灌路徑。~Check gate-bottom and water-level datums, comparing position feedback with physical travel and leakage. Retain gate and pump timestamps during interface tests, and use approved operating documentation to verify that transitions do not create a blocked discharge or backflow path.
units.failure: 只算外側三角水壓會漏掉內側抵銷，誤用水位差平方則不能代替兩水深平方差；關閉回饋失真或漂流物夾住時，抽水站仍可能持續承受倒灌。~Using only outside pressure omits interior opposition, while squaring the level difference cannot replace the difference of squared depths. False closed feedback or trapped debris can leave a backflow path despite the station’s indicated state.
units.misconception: 閘門兩側淨水壓只需把水位差平方，與各側實際水深無關。~Net gate pressure depends only on squared level difference, not the individual water depths.
units.practice: 畫出兩側三角壓力圖並相減，和只用水位差平方的錯誤結果比較。另列位置訊號與實際漏水兩種驗證，說明它們為何不能互相代替。~Draw and subtract the two triangular pressure diagrams, comparing the result with the incorrect squared-level-difference method. Separately list position-signal and leakage checks, explaining why neither substitutes for the other.

units.anchor: 單機停用與整站能力~Unit outage and station capability
units.title: 單機停用與整站能力機理與驗證~Unit outage and station capability mechanism and verification
units.mechanism: 備援台數只有在實際揚程、電源和管路條件下才有意義，保留一台泵不代表任何故障都能維持完整排水。多台可能共用變壓器、閘門、攔污設備或控制，因此機械可用性不等於整站可用性；故障情境應把剩餘排量與儲水時間一起評估，並辨認共因失效。本例每台排量已指定為相同實際揚程下的可用量，假設停機不改變其他台工作點；真實並聯工況須重新求解。~Spare-unit counts matter only at actual head, electrical and pipe conditions. One spare does not preserve full drainage for every fault. Units can share a transformer, gate, screen or controller, so mechanical availability is not station availability. Failure scenarios should compare retained flow with storage time and identify common causes across the complete system. Each unit’s stated flow is available at the same actual head, and an outage is assumed not to shift other operating points. Real parallel-system performance must be solved again.
units.model: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設三台各可排2.0 m³/s、需求5.0 m³/s；一台停用後可用4.0 m³/s，瞬時缺口為1.0 m³/s。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume three units each available at 2.0 m³/s and demand 5.0 m³/s. One outage leaves 4.0 m³/s, an instantaneous shortfall of 1.0 m³/s.
units.verify: 逐一列出單泵、電源、攔污與共同管路故障，確認剩餘流量不是直接沿用正常工況。以可用儲量演算缺口持續時間，並測試故障旗標和人工接管介面，保存實際限制而非只報備援台數。~List pump, supply, screen and common-pipe failures, checking that retained flow is not simply copied from normal operation. Route shortfalls through available storage, test fault indication and manual takeover interfaces, and document real limitations rather than reporting only the number of spare units.
units.failure: 三台泵共用一個失效配電盤時，名義備援無法保留排量；以正常單台能力乘剩餘台數也可能忽略新揚程，導致可支撐的洪水時間被高估。~If three pumps share one failed switchboard, nominal redundancy preserves no flow. Multiplying normal unit capacity by remaining count may also miss changed head and overstate the duration for which storage can bridge the flood.
units.misconception: 設有一台備用泵就能保證抽水站任何單一故障都不減排水量。~One spare pump guarantees unchanged station discharge under every single failure.
units.practice: 建立至少三種故障的剩餘能力表，將共同電源故障與單泵故障分開。把一個排量缺口轉成池水位變化，說明儲水只能提供有限緩衝而非永久替代抽排。~Build retained-capacity cases for at least three failures, separating shared-power loss from a single-pump outage. Convert one flow shortfall into sump rise and explain why storage provides a finite buffer rather than a permanent substitute for pumping.

example: 敏感度沿用兩台相同泵的Hp=10−0.25q²與系統H=Hs+0.20Q²，流量以m³/s、揚程以m表示且Q=2q。靜揚程Hs由3.0增至3.3 m，增加10%，兩台總流量由5.164降至5.052 m³/s，約減少2.17%。此例不是說所有外水位上升都只減少少量排水，而是展示實際變化由泵與系統曲線共同決定；若新交點超出允許工況，簡化曲線就不能繼續外推。效率、電功率、汽蝕及儲水演算需在新工作點重新檢查。~Use two identical pumps with Hp=10−0.25q² and system H=Hs+0.20Q², flows in m³/s, heads in meters and Q=2q. Increasing static head Hs from 3.0 to 3.3 m, or ten percent, reduces combined flow from 5.164 to 5.052 m³/s, approximately 2.17%. This does not imply that rising receiving water always causes only a small drainage loss. It demonstrates that the response follows both pump and system curves. A new intersection outside allowable operation invalidates extrapolation of the simplified curve. Efficiency, electrical power, cavitation and storage routing all need reassessment at the new operating point.
history: 上環雨水抽水站於2009年啟用，業主說明其地下儲水、閘門和抽水共同處理低窪區與潮水問題。西部封閉綜合工程於2012年八月首次為風暴事件關閉閘門並操作抽水，提供大型外水阻隔與內水排除的比較。香港2018年雨水手冊涵蓋防洪抽水設施，工兵團官方目錄則確認2020年機電設計手冊版本。本課核對的是這些歷史與技術範圍，沒有將舊版同名PDF誤稱新版全文，也沒有推定任何列名工程使用假設泵曲線。~Sheung Wan was commissioned in 2009; its owner describes underground storage, gates and pumps addressing low ground and tidal backflow. The West Closure Complex first closed gates and pumped for a storm event in August 2012, providing a larger-scale comparison of exterior protection and interior drainage. Hong Kong’s 2018 drainage manual covers flood pumping, and the USACE official catalogue confirms its 2020 mechanical/electrical manual edition. These historical facts and scopes were checked without mislabeling an older same-named PDF as the new full text or attributing hypothetical pump curves to either project.

facts: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設入流Qi=6、抽排Qp=4 m³/s、時間Δt=300 s、有效面積A=600 m²，水位升幅Δh=(Qi−Qp)Δt/A=1.00 m。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume inflow Qi=6, pumping Qp=4 m³/s, Δt=300 s and effective area A=600 m². Rise Δh=(Qi−Qp)Δt/A=1.00 m.

原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設靜揚程Hs=3.0 m、損失係數K=0.20 s²/m⁵、流量Q=4.0 m³/s，Hsys=Hs+KQ²=6.20 m。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume static head Hs=3.0 m, loss coefficient K=0.20 s²/m⁵ and flow Q=4.0 m³/s. System head Hsys=Hs+KQ²=6.20 m.

原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設單泵Hp=10−0.25q² m、系統Hs=3+0.20Q² m，q、Q以m³/s計；兩泵Q=2q得Q=2√(7/1.05)=5.164 m³/s。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume pump Hp=10−0.25q² m and system Hs=3+0.20Q² m, with q,Q in m³/s. Two pumps give Q=2q=2√(7/1.05)=5.164 m³/s.

原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設ρ=1000 kg/m³、Q=4 m³/s、H=6 m、ηp=0.75、ηm=0.95，P=ρgQH/(ηpηm)=330.44 kW，g=9.81 m/s²。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume ρ=1000 kg/m³, Q=4 m³/s, H=6 m, ηp=0.75, ηm=0.95 and g=9.81 m/s². Input P=ρgQH/(ηpηm)=330.44 kW.

原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設轉速比N2/N1=0.90，相似點Q2/Q1=0.90、H2/H1=0.81、P2/P1=0.729。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume speed ratio N2/N1=0.90. At homologous points Q2/Q1=0.90, H2/H1=0.81 and P2/P1=0.729.

原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設A=100 m²、啟停差Δh=0.60 m、Qi=0.50、Qp=2.0 m³/s；循環T=60/0.50+60/(2−0.50)=160 s，即22.5次/h。~Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume A=100 m², level band Δh=0.60 m, Qi=0.50 and Qp=2.0 m³/s. Cycle T=60/0.50+60/(2−0.50)=160 s, or 22.5 starts/h.
